purpose: Define BR204 FULL178 resume-first execution with 250 durable (b,d-band) checkpoints, transitive recovery prefixes, independent pilot salvage, and automatic execution only from a dedicated runkey-only push after audit.

audited_predecessor.scope: previous manual-dispatch cold doorstep; launcher topology is now being redesigned to runkey-push and therefore requires a fresh audit before generation 1

live_main_refresh.execution_freshness_rule: Heavy authorize must fetch origin/main and require this exact repository_main_head and MAIN-STATE blob. Any later main movement fails closed and requires a new cold doorstep refresh before execution.

objective_semantics.per_unit_output: Each durable (b,d-band) subunit emits exact merged (s,B,capacity) bins for BR202 K8 and BR203 mu plus d-dependent L>8/K8-tail-slot counters. Static BC state/mass metadata are repeated per band, must agree byte-semantically within b, and are counted once per b by the aggregator.
objective_semantics.k8_tail_slot_semantics: For a compact BC state with more than eight exact qBC levels, parts 1..7 are exact and part 8 is the K8 relaxed slot containing exact level 8 plus all deeper-level mass evaluated at q8. Do not reinterpret the slot as only qBC levels >8.
objective_semantics.global_composition: validate exact coverage of the approved 250 (b,d-band) subunits; count static BC population once per b; union all d-dependent exact capacities across subunits; group bins by exact rational ratio s/B; then solve one descending exact-rational ratio-class LP against the retained envelope
objective_semantics.equal_ratio_rule: Forced tail selection is computed only after summing capacity and tail-slot capacity over every bin with the same exact Fraction(s,B), so attribution is representation/order independent.
objective_semantics.forbidden: sum or average per-b LP floors; order equal-ratio bins to manufacture tail activity; materialize raw 4.1M routing-state JSON; terminal-identity fallback

qbc_tail_certificate.per_subunit_commitment: SHA256 of the complete validated (b,d-band) stream, including b/d-band/source locks and TAIL fields
global_checks: approved d bands are pairwise disjoint and cover every admissible even d exactly once for each b
all repeated static state/mass/tail metadata agree across bands of the same b and are counted exactly once per b
L<=8 plus L>8 static base-state partition equals H96 compact-state census
mu tail-slot capacities are subsets of mu capacities and mu<=K8
global ratio-class forced-tail attribution is exact and order independent
qbc_tail_certificate.br205_gate_firewall: Heavy result may emit raw and stronger tail-activity candidates, but formal BR205 gate remains false until the heavy result is hostile-audited and separately promoted.

resume_contract.generation_start_recovery: For generation >=2, the immediately previous failed/cancelled/timed-out BR204 run id is carried in the runkey. Recover its br204-prefix plus all completed br204-u-* artifacts, validate their exact union, re-emit one current prefix, and only then compute missing subunits.
resume_contract.cancellation_semantics: A failed generation leaves one inherited validated prefix plus every independently uploaded completed subunit. The next runkey-only generation commit names that immediately previous BR204 run id, so only true missing work is recomputed.
resume_contract.reuse_rule: accept a carried (b,d-band) subunit only after exact worker/base source-lock validation, approved-band identity validation, complete TAIL/SUM parse, and deterministic raw-stream digest validation; conflicting duplicates fail closed; compute only units absent from the re-emitted prefix/current artifacts
resume_contract.pilot_salvage: The two representative pilots are separate jobs and each uploads its own durable subunit immediately. If one fails, a completed sibling remains reusable.
resume_contract.cleanup_rule: Only after the new recovery prefix is successfully uploaded, delete the superseded prior run's BR204 recovery artifacts. Cleanup failure is a hard execution stop before new heavy compute.
resume_contract.reopened_or_non_arm_behavior: A runkey push whose commit message is not the dedicated execution prefix is skipped before authorize. Cold audit/setup commits never start heavy compute.

storage_contract.bin_stream_note: Transient exact bin streams are now persisted per (b,d-band) durable subunit, never as raw routing-state streams.
storage_contract.high_mass_scaleout_gate: Two representative pilots, (b=0,d=8..54) and (b=96,d=148..192), execute only after authorization and are reused as durable subunits.
storage_contract.projection_rule: 250 * max(two independently available pilot gzip sizes) * 2 + 20 MiB must be <= 500 MiB before fan-out
storage_contract.absolute_peak_rule: At generation rollover, at most one prior recovery union and one newly re-emitted prefix coexist: 2 * 250 * 900,000 bytes + 20 MiB <= 500 MiB. After fail-closed cleanup, current prefix plus newly completed missing units still represent at most 250 subunits.
storage_contract.recovery_retention: All BR204 recovery artifacts use 1-day retention, but superseded prior recovery artifacts are actively deleted after successful prefix re-emission so repeated generations do not accumulate one-day copies.

authorization.initial_execution_rule: After fresh hostile-audit PASS on the cold doorstep, one runkey-only commit changes generation 0->1 and armed false->true, binds the audited doorstep head/review, uses the dedicated execution commit-message prefix, and its push automatically starts heavy.
authorization.recovery_execution_rule: After a generation >=1 heavy run fails/cancels/times out, a runkey-only child commit keeps armed=true, increments generation by exactly one, supplies carry_run_id for the immediately previous generation run, preserves all execution/source/resume/storage/credit locks, and its push automatically resumes missing work only.

required_checks: 250-subunit exact coverage/disjointness over approved b x d-band units
every admissible even d covered exactly once per b
repeated per-b static metadata agrees across retained bands
multi-generation recovery prefix validates and re-emits the exact union before new compute
both pilot subunits are independently durable/salvageable
H96 refined-state census counted once per b
H96 BC assignment-mass conservation counted once per b
global mu LP <= global K8 LP
post_run_gates.br205_gate: Only after the heavy result establishes exact FULL178 L>8/tail-slot activity and, for the stronger diagnostic, positive forced-selected tail-slot capacity under the order-independent global LP; any formal BR205 authorization additionally requires hostile audit.
post_run_gates.main_credit: requires separate hostile audit and MAIN MIN/replacement consumption; never automatic
